reason: A user-facing utility that provides temperature and maxTokens sliders, with temporary or persistent settings, and applies those values to model requests across providers.

summaries.zh: 通过界面滑杆调整所有模型调用的 temperature 和 maxTokens，并支持临时或持久化生效。
summaries.en: Adjusts temperature and maxTokens for model calls through UI sliders with temporary or persistent settings.

capabilities: Provides UI sliders for temperature and maxTokens
Persists sampling settings or applies them temporarily for the current run
Intercepts agent/request configuration and merges selected sampling values for all providers
